name: Ghost of Gunsmoke
source:
You're a bounty hunter living on No Man's Land, barely scrapping by with your mysterious robot companion. One day, you come across someone from your past and grab the interest of a certain Humanoid Typhoon...

(from https://aquaberri.itch.io/ghost-of-gunsmoke-demo)
